title: UAP moving at Mach 40 explained as larger observer matrices

tellings.quote: So this is when we get to the UAP kind of stuff where, right, you

plain: A UAP, the government's word for a UFO, seen moving at forty times the speed of sound might be explained by what the scientist Donald Hoffman calls larger observer matrices, a term from his own mathematical theory of observers. Hoffman brings this up as the point where his ideas meet UFO reports, offering it as his own theory rather than from any source.
